<script>
(function () {
  var talkLocations = [
    { city: "Boston, MA", lat: 42.3601, lng: -71.0589, count: 1, items: [
      "ASCO Quality Care Symposium — 2026"
    ]},
    { city: "Berlin, Germany", lat: 52.5200, lng: 13.4050, count: 1, items: [
      "Fast-Track Cities 2026 — 2026"
    ]},
    { city: "New Orleans, LA", lat: 29.9511, lng: -90.0715, count: 4, items: [
      "US Fast-Track Cities 2025 Summit — 2025 (2 talks)",
      "Fast Track Cities Steering Committee — 2024",
      "ENAR 2025 (Conference Chair) — 2025"
    ]},
    { city: "Indianapolis, IN", lat: 39.7684, lng: -86.1581, count: 2, items: [
      "ENAR — 2026",
      "ENAR 2026 (Conference Chair) — 2026"
    ]},
    { city: "Nashville, TN", lat: 36.1627, lng: -86.7816, count: 1, items: [
      "JSM 2025 (Conference Chair) — 2025"
    ]},
    { city: "Portland, OR", lat: 45.5152, lng: -122.6784, count: 1, items: [
      "JSM 2024 (Conference Chair) — 2024"
    ]},
    { city: "Denver, CO", lat: 39.7392, lng: -104.9903, count: 2, items: [
      "CROI — 2026 (2 talks)"
    ]},
    { city: "Birmingham, AL", lat: 33.5186, lng: -86.8104, count: 3, items: [
      "UAB GIS Day — 2025",
      "CFAR Seminar Series — 2025",
      "Fineberg Award, UAB Dept. of Biostatistics — 2024"
    ]},
    { city: "Atlanta, GA", lat: 33.7490, lng: -84.3880, count: 3, items: [
      "IDWeek — 2025",
      "Esri Southeast User Conference — 2025",
      "ENAR — 2018"
    ]},
    { city: "Chicago, IL", lat: 41.8781, lng: -87.6298, count: 1, items: [
      "ASCO Quality Care Symposium — 2025"
    ]},
    { city: "Boulder, CO", lat: 40.0150, lng: -105.2705, count: 1, items: [
      "Spatial Statistics 2023 (SPAT) — 2023"
    ]},
    { city: "Seattle, WA", lat: 47.6062, lng: -122.3321, count: 1, items: [
      "CROI — 2023"
    ]}
  ];

  function initTalksMap() {
    var mapDiv = document.getElementById("talks-map");
    if (!mapDiv || typeof L === "undefined") return;

    var map = L.map("talks-map", { scrollWheelZoom: false });

    L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
      maxZoom: 18,
      attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors'
    }).addTo(map);

    var markers = [];
    talkLocations.forEach(function (loc) {
      var radius = 7 + loc.count * 2.5;
      var marker = L.circleMarker([loc.lat, loc.lng], {
        radius: radius,
        color: "#7a1f2b",
        weight: 2,
        fillColor: "#7a1f2b",
        fillOpacity: 0.55
      }).addTo(map);

      var popupHtml = "<strong>" + loc.city + "</strong> (" + loc.count +
        (loc.count === 1 ? " talk" : " talks") +
        ')<ul style="margin:0.4rem 0 0; padding-left:1.1rem;">';
      loc.items.forEach(function (item) {
        popupHtml += "<li>" + item + "</li>";
      });
      popupHtml += "</ul>";
      marker.bindPopup(popupHtml);
      markers.push(marker);
    });

    var group = L.featureGroup(markers);
    map.fitBounds(group.getBounds().pad(0.25));
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initTalksMap);
  } else {
    initTalksMap();
  }
})();
</script>
